wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/run_audit.py: """Audits the branch with GLM 5.2, Kimi K2.7 and Kimi K3, in SEQUENCE.

Independent parallel juries were tried on this repo before and the result is recorded: two jurors
agreeing was REFUTED by measurement, and the worst defect came only from the third. So this runs
them in sequence — each sees what the previous ones found — and round two asks every juror to
attack the findings, INCLUDING the ones already confirmed. Agreement is a signal about where to
measure, never the verdict.

The models are `:cloud`, so they cost this machine no RAM and no cores; the local test suite keeps
running beside
